convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (e-Regr custom regression indicator) which requires the custom .ex5 file; also has complex virtual stop management and conditional position sizing logic

params.description: SL is virtual (hidden from broker); StopLoss input parameter in points
TP is virtual (hidden from broker); TakeProfit input parameter in points

other_exits: Virtual stop-loss: EA monitors price and closes position when price crosses virtual SL level
Virtual take-profit: EA monitors price and closes position when price crosses virtual TP level
Regression channel opposite band touch can trigger close

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots input is negative, uses fixed lot size (absolute value); if positive, uses Lots as fraction of free margin (deposit fraction sizing)

custom_logic_notes: Uses virtual (hidden) stop-loss and take-profit instead of broker-visible stops. Virtual SL/TP levels are calculated from entry price and monitored on each tick. StopLoss and TakeProfit inputs are in points, adjusted for 5-digit brokers. Position sizing is dual-mode: negative Lots = fixed lots, positive Lots = fraction of free margin. The regression channel degree and Kstd multiplier affect channel width which indirectly controls entry frequency. Signal uses previous completed bar (shift 1) for all indicator comparisons.
python_conversion_notes: Must implement polynomial regression channel from scratch since e-Regr is a custom indicator. The regression channel calculation (degree, period, standard deviation multiplier) is the core dependency. Virtual SL/TP logic requires tick-level monitoring for accurate backtest. The dual position sizing mode (negative=fixed, positive=fraction) must be handled. Digit adjustment logic (multiplying by 10 for 5-digit) must be replicated. New bar detection is essential for signal generation timing.
